preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 3 and 300 inclusive.
The number of columns m must be between 3 and 300 inclusive.
The desired time t must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The time tp for flat ground must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The time tu for ascent must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The time td for descent must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= height <= 10**6 for row in heights for height in row)
preconditions.description: Each height value in the grid must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The upper left row number must be between 1 and n inclusive, and the lower right row number must be between the upper left row number and n inclusive.
The upper left column number must be between 1 and m inclusive, and the lower right column number must be between the upper left column number and m inclusive.
The number of rows in the selected rectangle must be at least 3.
The number of columns in the selected rectangle must be at least 3.

postconditions.expression: abs(ts - t) == min(abs(ts - t) for ts in all_possible_times)
postconditions.description: The time ts of passing the selected track must be as close to t as possible among all possible tracks.
